raw.query: WITH current_runs AS (SELECT run_id FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current), composed AS (SELECT image_px, n_images, mean_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE is_valid AND source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/vit_compile.json' AND engine = 'compiled'), vllm AS (SELECT image_px, n_images, mean_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE is_valid AND source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/vllm_eager_vit.json' AND engine = 'vllm'), pairs AS (SELECT c.image_px, c.n_images, c.mean_ms AS composed_ms, v.mean_ms AS vllm_ms, 100.0 * ABS(c.mean_ms - v.mean_ms) / v.mean_ms AS pct_vs_vllm FROM composed c JOIN vllm v USING (image_px, n_images)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS comparable_points, ROUND(MAX(pct_vs_vllm)::numeric, 3) AS max_pct_vs_vllm, STRING_AGG(n_images::text || ' images: ' || composed_ms::text || ' vs ' || vllm_ms::text || ' ms = ' || ROUND(pct_vs_vllm::numeric, 3)::text || '%', ', ' ORDER BY n_images) AS breakdown FROM pairs
